interfaces_confirmed.private_request_port: RuntimeToolRequest is an in-process domain struct. Existing runtimeToolGate constructs it with keyed fields; no wire capture producer is present in the reviewed Main baseline.
interfaces_confirmed.old_run_semantics: sandbox.Run calls Start(ctx, command, empty options) and then Wait(context.Background()). Wait(ctx) returns immediately on ctx cancellation and does not imply cleanup completion.
interfaces_confirmed.receipt_staging: No StagingDirectory field exists in Receipt. Match Directory=staging/output, Executable=staging/input/go/bin/go.exe, and full remapped argv, including -C staging/input/source.
interfaces_confirmed.capabilities: Must remain empty for usable capture.
interfaces_confirmed.native_file_api: Locked x/sys/windows provides NtCreateFile with OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES.RootDirectory, OBJ_DONT_REPARSE, FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and directory/non-directory options; GetFileInformationByHandle exposes NumberOfLinks. Actual handle-relative no-follow, exact enumeration and one-link behavior must be reviewed and fixture-tested after freeze, not inferred from os.Root.
interfaces_confirmed.deliverygate: Validate is syntax/token/AST/type/byte validation only, binds owned raw bytes and returns defensive copies. It does not execute or prove Clamp correctness.
interfaces_confirmed.evidence_bound: Host bound marshals the full object before comparing 4MiB. Domain broker removes host_evidence from the model response and independently bounds/canonically hashes it. Capture must be attached before these existing bounds.
